findings.finding: Still present at 69fe17c, unchanged since Review r1. qemu (driver.go:221), firecracker (driver_linux.go:218) and vz (driver.go:237) each pass `req.Link().Claim()` with no tier-0 test that the claim carries it; only Hyper-V has one. A regression that drops the link is loud on qemu and firecracker (the relay answers 400 'build_link is required') and quiet on vz (host mode falls back to its --subnet default). Jeff chose to leave this for Consolidation.
findings.suggestion: Add one tier-0 assertion per driver that the claim it sends carries the request's link. The order-test seams from item 5 can capture the ClaimRelay arguments, or the shared claim-building call can be factored and tested once with every driver as a caller. At minimum cover vz, the quiet case.

findings.finding: Implement's note for this round, confirmed. Resolving r1 SHOULDs 2 and 3 changed shipped behaviour beyond the design text. (a) Doctor now fails on a missing or stale stamp on an asset every build uses: the hyperv relay boot VHDX and the vz prepared image (driver/hostlink.go LauncherStamp.Required/Blocks, cmd/warden/host.go:265). Decision 8 and the design's pseudocode (design:762, 'doctor (each VM driver): ... each stamp's state') still describe a doctor that only prints. (b) A vz --image disk outside the cache now gets a different fix ('omit --image ...', driver/vz/driver.go customImageFix). The change is not silent: Jeff sent SHOULDs 2 and 3 to this Implement round (r3 addendum), and SHOULD 2's suggestion was this behaviour. The user docs are updated (cli.md, drivers.md, host.go help). But plan task 56 (design:1781) only folds in the a14 (d) answer, 'with no change of substance beyond it'. As written, Consolidation would leave the design describing the old doctor.
findings.suggestion: At Consolidation, widen task 56 (or add a line to the Consolidation section) so Decision 8 and the design:762 pseudocode record the two behaviours. (a) Doctor is BLOCKED and exits non-zero on a missing or stale stamp on the hyperv relay boot VHDX and the vz prepared image, and only reports one on the qemu and firecracker direct-boot initramfs. (b) A vz --image outside the cache gets the 'omit --image' fix. Cite Review r1 SHOULDs 2 and 3 as the source.
